name: How do I know if my fence needs stability restoration?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my fence needs stability restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs that your fence needs stability restoration include leaning sections, loose posts, broken or rotting pickets, sagging gates, and visible cracks or damage to the fence material. If you notice your fence swaying excessively in the wind or if there are gaps appearing at the bottom where there weren't before, these are also indicators. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage and more costly repairs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for leaning sections, loose posts, broken pickets, sagging gates, visible cracks, or excessive swaying to determine if your fence needs restoration.
